agyos_skill.intent: Use when asking clients for testimonials, designing maintenance and support retainers, identifying upsell or cross-sell opportunities, or offboarding freelance clients.
agyos_skill.instructions: Convert one-time projects into long-term relationships through systematic testimonials, maintenance retainers, strategic upsells, and professional offboarding. To utilize this skill's retention tactics, support agreements, or offboarding scripts, read the corresponding document in the `references/` directory: | File | Focus | Purpose | |------|-------|---------| | [05A-TESTIMONIALS-REVIEWS.md](references/05A-TESTIMONIALS-REVIEWS.md) | Testimonials & Reviews | Collection strategies, 3-Ask testimonial template, video testimonial script, portfolio display formats | | [05B-MAINTENANCE-RETAINERS.md](references/05B-MAINTAINERS-RETAINERS.md) | Maintenance & Retainers | Recurring revenue models, support SLA tiers (Basic, Growth, Authority), uptime and latency terms | | [05C-UPSELL-CROSS-SELL.md](references/05C-UPSELL-CROSS-SELL.md) | Upsell & Cross-Sell | Timing matrix, cross-sell services (dashboarding, security audits, scaling, API migration) | | [05D-OFFBOARDING.md](references/05D-OFFBOARDING.md) | Offboarding | Asset transfer checklists, final payment collection, relationship close ritual | When assisting a freelancer with collecting client feedback: - Reference [05A-TESTIMONIALS-REVIEWS.md](references/05A-TESTIMONIALS-REVIEWS.md) to execute the **3-Ask Testimonial Method** (kickoff expectations $\rightarrow$ delivery day prompt $\rightarrow$ 30 days post-live request). - Format questions to capture before/after metrics and specific ROI outcomes rather than generic compliments. - Guide the client to record a video testimonial using the structured 4-step script. When asked to convert a project into a recurring retainer or draft an SLA: - Reference [05B-MAINTENANCE-RETAINERS.md](references/05B-MAINTAINERS-RETAINERS.md) to define support tiers (Starter, Growth, Authority). - Specify response times (e.g., 24-hour vs 4-hour SLA), server monitoring frequency, bug resolution, and monthly allocation boundaries. When identifying revenue expansion opportunities: - Reference [05C-UPSELL-CROSS-SELL.md](references/05C-UPSELL-CROSS-SELL.md) to map adjacent needs to completed projects. - Pitch value-add services such as: dashboarding, automation syncs, model retraining cycles, security Audits, or scaling systems. When managing the final phase of a client relationship: - Reference [05D-OFFBOARDING.md](references/05D-OFFBOARDING.md) to guide safe asset transfer (credentials, code repositories, data stores) and secure final invoice payments. - Send the offboarding summary email that leaves the door open for future collaboration or referrals. | Concept | File | Section | One-Line Summary | |---------|------|---------|------------------| | 3-Ask Loop | [05A](references/05A-TESTIMONIALS-REVIEWS.md) | 1 | Ask at kickoff, ask on launch day, ask 30 days post-launch | | Video Testimonial Script | [05A](references/05A-TESTIMONIALS-REVIEWS.md) | 2 | 4-step blueprint: Prior State $\rightarrow$ Solution $\rightarrow$ Result $\rightarrow$ Recommendation |
